# istio_workload_group (Resource)

Manages an Istio WorkloadGroup resource. WorkloadGroups provide a template for a collection of workload instances, similar to how Deployments manage Pods.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "istio_workload_group" "vm_group" {
  manifest = jsonencode({
    apiVersion = "networking.istio.io/v1"
    kind       = "WorkloadGroup"
    metadata = {
      name      = "my-vm-group"
      namespace = "default"
    }
    spec = {
      metadata = {
        labels = {
          app     = "my-app"
          version = "v1"
        }
      }
      template = {
        serviceAccount = "my-app-sa"
      }
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (String) Full WorkloadGroup manifest as a JSON string. Must include `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata.name`, and `metadata.namespace`. The `apiVersion` in the manifest determines which API version is used (e.g. `networking.istio.io/v1` or an older version like `v1beta1`). Sensitive fields (tokens, keys, passwords, etc.) are redacted to "(redacted)" in state after read.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the format `namespace/name` (or `name` for cluster-scoped resources).
